422	    def _create_run(self, run, plan):
423	        """Append creation events and persist a freshly built run.
424	
425	        A run with a future ``not_before`` stays fully ``pending``: its root
426	        nodes are opened (one ``ready``/``waiting`` history event each) only
427	        when the first claim arrives at or after that time.  A past, present
428	        or missing start time opens the roots immediately, exactly like the
429	        legacy create behavior.
430	        """
431	        run_id = run["run_id"]
432	        self._event(run, run_id, None, "run_created")
433	        not_before = run.get("not_before")
434	        if not_before is None or float(not_before) <= self.now():
435	            self._open_root_nodes(run)
436	        run["status"], run["updated_at"] = _derive_run_status(run), self._iso()
437	        return self.store.save_run(run)
438	
439	    def _open_root_nodes(self, run, when=None):
440	        """Promote every pending node whose dependencies all succeeded.
441	
442	        Each promoted node records exactly one ``ready`` or ``waiting``
443	        history event, so calling this on repeated claims never re-opens a
444	        node.  Returns ``(ready_ids, waiting_ids)``.
445	        """
446	        now_iso = self._iso() if when is None else when
447	        ready, waiting = _promote_pending(run, now_iso)
448	        for sid in ready:
449	            self._event(run, run["run_id"], sid, "ready",
450	                        attempt=run["steps"][sid]["attempt"])
451	        for sid in waiting:
452	            self._event(run, run["run_id"], sid, "waiting", attempt=0)
453	        return ready, waiting
454	
455	    def get_run(self, tenant, run_id):
456	        run = self.store.load_run(tenant, run_id)
457	        if run["tenant"] != tenant:
458	            raise WorkflowError("run %s belongs to another tenant" % run_id, "cross_tenant")
459	        return run

461	    def list_runs(self, tenant, status=None, limit=50, after=None):
462	        return self.store.list_runs(tenant, status=status, limit=limit, after=after)

464	    # -- audit stream ---------------------------------------------------
465	    def list_audit(self, tenant, action=None, run_id=None, limit=100, after=0):
466	        """Read the tenant's audit stream; never mutates any state.
467	
468	        Returns ``(items, next_after)`` where ``items`` are the tenant's
469	        audit records with ``sequence > after`` (optionally filtered by
470	        ``action`` and/or ``run_id``) in ascending sequence order, at most
471	        ``limit`` of them, and ``next_after`` is the sequence of the last
472	        record of the page, or ``None`` when no further records follow.
473	        Only the requesting tenant's own stream is ever read.
474	        """
475	        tenant = normalize_tenant(tenant)
476	        if action is not None:
477	            if not isinstance(action, str) or not action.strip():
478	                raise WorkflowError("action must be a non-empty string", "bad_action")
479	            action = action.strip()
480	        if run_id is not None:
481	            if not isinstance(run_id, str) or not run_id.strip():
482	                raise WorkflowError("run_id must be a non-empty string", "bad_run_id")
483	            run_id = run_id.strip()
484	        if isinstance(limit, bool) or not isinstance(limit, int) or not 1 <= limit <= 1000:
485	            raise WorkflowError("limit must be an integer between 1 and 1000", "bad_limit")
486	        if isinstance(after, bool) or not isinstance(after, int) or after < 0:
487	            raise WorkflowError("after must be a non-negative integer", "bad_after")
488	        with self.store.locked():
489	            matched = [r for r in self.store.load_audit(tenant) if r["sequence"] > after]
490	        if action is not None:
491	            matched = [r for r in matched if r["action"] == action]
492	        if run_id is not None:
493	            matched = [r for r in matched if r.get("run_id") == run_id]
494	        matched.sort(key=lambda r: r["sequence"])
495	        page = matched[:limit]
496	        next_after = page[-1]["sequence"] if len(matched) > limit else None
497	        return page, next_after
498	
499	    def history(self, run_id, tenant=None):

502	            if tenant is None:
503	                raise WorkflowError("unknown run: %s" % run_id, "unknown_run")
504	        return list(self.get_run(tenant, run_id)["history"])

507	    def create_schedule(self, tenant, schedule_id, workflow_id, interval_seconds,
508	                        first_at=None, params=None, max_parallelism=None):
509	        """Create a persistent periodic schedule for one tenant.
510	
511	        ``first_at`` omitted (or ``null``) defaults to the current time.
512	        Returns the stored record; a duplicate id within the same tenant
513	        conflicts (``schedule_exists``).
514	        """
515	        tenant = normalize_tenant(tenant)
516	        schedule_id = normalize_schedule_id(schedule_id)
517	        interval = normalize_interval_seconds(interval_seconds)
518	        first_at = normalize_first_at(first_at)
519	        params = normalize_schedule_params(params)
520	        max_parallelism = normalize_max_parallelism(max_parallelism)
521	        with self.store.locked():
522	            schedules = self.store.load_schedules(tenant)
523	            if schedule_id in schedules:
524	                raise ConflictError(
525	                    "schedule already exists: %s" % schedule_id, "schedule_exists"
526	                )
527	            plan = self.store.get_workflow(tenant, workflow_id)
528	            now = self.now()
529	            next_at = now if first_at is None else first_at
530	            record = {
531	                "tenant": tenant,
532	                "schedule_id": schedule_id,
533	                "workflow_id": plan["workflow_id"],
534	                "interval_seconds": interval,
535	                "first_at": next_at,
536	                "next_at": next_at,
537	                "params": params,
538	                "max_parallelism": max_parallelism,
539	                "created_at": self._iso(now),
540	                "updated_at": self._iso(now),
541	            }
542	            schedules[schedule_id] = record
543	            self.store.save_schedules(tenant, schedules)
544	            self.store.append_audit(tenant, "schedule.create", schedule_id=schedule_id,

548	    def list_schedules(self, tenant):
549	        """Return the tenant's schedules sorted by schedule_id."""

552	            schedules = self.store.load_schedules(tenant)

555	    def dispatch_schedule(self, tenant, schedule_id):
556	        """Fire a schedule when due.
557	
558	        Returns ``(run, scheduled_at)`` when a run was created, or
559	        ``(None, None)`` when the schedule is not yet due (HTTP 204).  Only
560	        the single due trigger point is processed per call: ``next_at``
561	        advances by exactly one interval, so a repeat before the next
562	        trigger is due changes nothing and missed trigger points are caught
563	        up one per call in chronological order.
564	        """
565	        tenant = normalize_tenant(tenant)
566	        schedule_id = normalize_schedule_id(schedule_id)
567	        now = self.now()
568	        with self.store.locked():
569	            owner = self.store.schedule_exists(schedule_id)
570	            if owner is None:
571	                raise WorkflowError(
572	                    "unknown schedule: %s" % schedule_id, "unknown_schedule"
573	                )
574	            if owner != tenant:
575	                raise WorkflowError(
576	                    "schedule %s belongs to another tenant" % schedule_id, "cross_tenant"
577	                )
578	            schedules = self.store.load_schedules(tenant)
579	            record = schedules[schedule_id]
580	            scheduled_at = float(record["next_at"])
581	            if now < scheduled_at:
582	                return None, None
583	            run = self.start_run(
584	                tenant,
585	                record["workflow_id"],
586	                params=record.get("params") or {},
587	                max_parallelism=record.get("max_parallelism"),
588	                schedule_id=schedule_id,
589	                scheduled_at=scheduled_at,
590	            )
591	            record["next_at"] = scheduled_at + float(record["interval_seconds"])
592	            record["updated_at"] = self._iso(now)
593	            schedules[schedule_id] = record
594	            self.store.save_schedules(tenant, schedules)
595	            self.store.append_audit(tenant, "schedule.dispatch", schedule_id=schedule_id,
596	                                    run_id=run["run_id"])
597	            return run, scheduled_at

599	    # -- worker registry -----------------------------------------------
600	    def _worker_view(self, record, now=None):
601	        """Project a stored registration record with live status."""
602	        now = self.now() if now is None else now
603	        deadline = float(record["expires_at_epoch"])
604	        return {
605	            "worker_id": record["worker_id"],
606	            "status": WORKER_ACTIVE if now < deadline else WORKER_EXPIRED,
607	            "registered_at": record["registered_at"],
608	            "last_heartbeat": record["last_heartbeat"],
609	            "expires_at": record["expires_at"],
610	        }

612	    def register_worker(self, tenant, worker_id, lease_seconds=None):
613	        """Register ``worker_id`` for ``tenant`` (or refresh its expiry).
614	
615	        Returns ``(record, created)`` where ``created`` is ``True`` for the
616	        first registration (HTTP 201) and ``False`` for a repeat that
617	        refreshed an existing record (HTTP 200).  Registration never writes
618	        run history.
619	        """
620	        tenant = normalize_tenant(tenant)
621	        worker_id = normalize_worker_id(worker_id)
622	        lease = normalize_worker_lease(lease_seconds)
623	        now = self.now()
624	        with self.store.locked():
625	            workers = self.store.load_workers(tenant)
626	            existing = workers.get(worker_id)
627	            deadline = now + lease
628	            at = self._iso(now)
629	            if existing is None:
630	                record = {
631	                    "worker_id": worker_id,
632	                    "registered_at": at,
633	                    "last_heartbeat": at,
634	                    "expires_at": self._iso(deadline),
635	                    "expires_at_epoch": deadline,
636	                }
637	                created = True
638	            else:
639	                # A repeat registration simply refreshes the expiry; the
640	                # original registered_at is preserved.
641	                record = dict(existing)
642	                record.update(last_heartbeat=at, expires_at=self._iso(deadline),
643	                              expires_at_epoch=deadline)
644	                created = False
645	            workers[worker_id] = record
646	            self.store.save_workers(tenant, workers)
647	            self.store.append_audit(tenant, "worker.register", worker_id=worker_id)
648	            return self._worker_view(record, now), created
649	
650	    def heartbeat_worker(self, tenant, worker_id, lease_seconds=None):
651	        """Heartbeat a registered worker.
652	
653	        The new expiry is the later of the old one and ``now +
654	        lease_seconds``.  Unknown workers raise ``unknown_worker`` (404) and
655	        workers whose registration has expired raise ``worker_expired``
656	        (409); an expired worker must re-register.
657	        """
658	        tenant = normalize_tenant(tenant)
659	        worker_id = normalize_worker_id(worker_id)
660	        lease = normalize_worker_lease(lease_seconds)
661	        now = self.now()
662	        with self.store.locked():
663	            workers = self.store.load_workers(tenant)
664	            record = workers.get(worker_id)
665	            if record is None:
666	                raise WorkflowError("unknown worker: %s" % worker_id, "unknown_worker")
667	            if now >= float(record["expires_at_epoch"]):
668	                raise ConflictError(
669	                    "worker_expired: registration of worker %s has expired; re-register"
670	                    % worker_id,
671	                    "worker_expired",
672	                )
673	            deadline = max(float(record["expires_at_epoch"]), now + lease)
674	            record = dict(record)
675	            record.update(last_heartbeat=self._iso(now), expires_at=self._iso(deadline),
676	                          expires_at_epoch=deadline)
677	            workers[worker_id] = record
678	            self.store.save_workers(tenant, workers)
679	            self.store.append_audit(tenant, "worker.heartbeat", worker_id=worker_id)
680	            return self._worker_view(record, now)

682	    def list_workers(self, tenant):
683	        """Return the tenant's worker records sorted by worker_id.
684	
685	        Status is computed against the current time on every call, so
686	        expired workers are reported without any background reaper.
687	        """
688	        tenant = normalize_tenant(tenant)
689	        now = self.now()
690	        with self.store.locked():
691	            workers = self.store.load_workers(tenant)
692	            return [self._worker_view(workers[worker_id], now)
693	                    for worker_id in sorted(workers)]

695	    def _check_worker_registration(self, tenant, worker_id, now):
696	        """Gate claims against the tenant's worker registry.
697	
698	        A tenant with no registration records keeps the legacy rule (any
699	        non-empty worker_id).  Once any record exists the caller must be a
700	        registered worker whose registration is strictly unexpired.
701	        """
702	        workers = self.store.load_workers(tenant)
703	        if not workers:
704	            return
705	        record = workers.get(worker_id)
706	        if record is None:
707	            raise ConflictError(
708	                "worker_not_registered: worker %s is not registered for tenant %s"
709	                % (worker_id, tenant),
710	                "worker_not_registered",
711	            )
712	        if now >= float(record["expires_at_epoch"]):
713	            raise ConflictError(
714	                "worker_expired: registration of worker %s has expired; re-register"
715	                % worker_id,
716	                "worker_expired",
717	            )

719	    # -- lease expiry --------------------------------------------------
720	    def _expire_leases(self, run, now):
721	        """Release leases past their deadline; each one records a takeover."""
722	        reclaimed = []
723	        for sid in sorted(run["steps"], key=lambda s: run["order_index"].get(s, 0)):
724	            step = run["steps"][sid]
725	            if step["status"] != STEP_RUNNING:
726	                continue
727	            if step.get("lease_deadline") is None or float(step["lease_deadline"]) > now:
728	                continue
729	            holder = step["worker_id"]
730	            step.update(status=STEP_READY, worker_id=None, lease_deadline=None, ready_at=self._iso())
731	            self._event(run, run["run_id"], sid, "takeover", attempt=step["attempt"], worker_id=holder)
732	            reclaimed.append(sid)
733	        return reclaimed
734	
735	    # -- claim / complete / fail ---------------------------------------
736	    def claim(self, tenant, run_id, worker_id, lease_seconds=30):
737	        """Lease the next ready step, or return ``None`` when none is ready.
738	
739	        A delayed run (a future ``not_before``) cannot be activated early:
740	        claims before the start time return ``None`` without touching its
741	        state, history or ``updated_at``.  The first claim at or after the
742	        start time opens the root nodes (one ``ready``/``waiting`` event each)
743	        and then leases at most one task under the usual order and quota; a
744	        run whose roots are all approvals activates and still returns ``None``.
745	
746	        Once the tenant has any registered worker the claim must come from an
747	        active registration (``worker_not_registered`` / ``worker_expired``);
748	        a tenant with no registrations keeps the legacy non-empty-id rule.
749	
750	        A ready step whose retry backoff is still pending
751	        (``next_attempt_at`` in the future) is not leased; other ready tasks
752	        whose backoff has elapsed are handed out in the usual order instead.
753	        When nothing is leased and no lease takeover or root activation
754	        happened, the run's state, history and ``updated_at`` are left
755	        exactly as stored.
756	        """
757	        if not isinstance(worker_id, str) or not worker_id.strip():
758	            raise WorkflowError("worker_id must be a non-empty string", "bad_worker")
759	        if not isinstance(lease_seconds, (int, float)) or isinstance(lease_seconds, bool) \
760	                or lease_seconds <= 0:
761	            raise WorkflowError("lease_seconds must be a positive number", "bad_lease")
762	        now = self.now()
763	        with self.store.locked():
764	            owner = self.store.run_exists(run_id)
765	            if owner is not None and owner != tenant:
766	                raise WorkflowError("run %s belongs to another tenant" % run_id, "cross_tenant")
767	            # Once a tenant has any registered worker, claims require an
768	            # active registration; a tenant without records keeps the legacy
769	            # "any non-empty worker_id" rule.
770	            self._check_worker_registration(tenant, worker_id.strip(), now)
771	            run = self.get_run(tenant, run_id)
772	            not_before = run.get("not_before")
773	            if not_before is not None and float(not_before) > now:
774	                # Still sleeping: activation happens only via a due claim.
775	                return None
776	            reclaimed = self._expire_leases(run, now)
777	            opened_ready, opened_waiting = self._open_root_nodes(run)
778	            now_iso = self._iso()
779	            candidates = [s for s in run["steps"].values()
780	                          if s["status"] == STEP_READY and _retry_due(s, now_iso)]
781	            index = run["order_index"]
782	            quota = run.get("max_parallelism")
783	            at_quota = quota is not None and _active_lease_count(run, now) >= int(quota)
784	            step = (min(candidates, key=lambda s: (index.get(s["id"], 0), s["id"]))
785	                    if candidates and not at_quota else None)
786	            previous = run["status"]
787	            if step is not None:
788	                step.update(status=STEP_RUNNING, worker_id=worker_id, next_attempt_at=None,
789	                            lease_deadline=now + float(lease_seconds), started_at=self._iso())
790	                self._event(run, run_id, step["id"], "claim", attempt=step["attempt"],
791	                            worker_id=worker_id, lease_deadline=step["lease_deadline"])
792	            elif not reclaimed and not opened_ready and not opened_waiting:
793	                # Nothing to lease and nothing else changed: keep the stored
794	                # state, history and updated_at untouched.
795	                return None
796	            run["status"] = _derive_run_status(run)
797	            if step is not None and run["status"] == RUN_RUNNING and previous == RUN_PENDING:
798	                self._event(run, run_id, None, "run_started")
799	            run["updated_at"] = self._iso()
800	            self.store.save_run(run)
801	            return dict(step) if step is not None else None
802	
803	    def claim_fair(self, tenant, worker_id, lease_seconds=30):
804	        """Lease one task from the tenant's least-claimed eligible run.
805	
806	        Scans every run of the tenant.  First, sleeping runs whose
807	        ``not_before`` has come due are activated (root nodes opened, one
808	        ``ready``/``waiting`` event each) in ``run_id`` order.  Then the
809	        candidates — runs that are not terminal, not still sleeping, hold at
810	        least one ``ready`` ordinary task whose retry backoff has elapsed
811	        (``next_attempt_at`` reached) and have not reached their
812	        ``max_parallelism`` — are ordered by fairness: the number of
813	        ``claim`` events in the run's history (fewest first), then
814	        ``created_at``, then ``run_id``.  A run holding only not-yet-due
815	        retries is skipped and its fairness count is left alone.  Expired
816	        leases are reclaimed with the usual ``takeover`` events before slots
817	        are counted, exactly like the single-run claim.  The winner leases
818	        its next due task in ``(topological index, step id)`` order,
819	        recording the usual ``claim`` and, when the run leaves ``pending``,
820	        ``run_started`` events.
821

167	        appends stay unique and follow commit order, and it continues from
168	        the persisted stream, so a restart keeps increasing.  Only
169	        identifiers and the actor are stored — never params, results or
170	        error text; identifiers that do not apply are ``None``.
171	        """
172	        with self._lock:
173	            path = self.audit_path(tenant)
174	            items = (read_json(path, None) or {}).get("items") or []
175	            record = {
176	                "sequence": (items[-1]["sequence"] + 1) if items else 1,
177	                "at": at if at is not None else self.now_iso(),
178	                "tenant": tenant.strip(),
179	                "action": action,
180	                "run_id": run_id,
181	                "step_id": step_id,
182	                "workflow_id": workflow_id,
183	                "schedule_id": schedule_id,
184	                "worker_id": worker_id,
185	                "actor": actor,
186	            }
187	            items.append(record)
188	            atomic_write_json(path, {"items": items})
189	            return dict(record)
190	
191	    def load_audit(self, tenant):
192	        """Return the tenant's audit records in sequence order (read-only)."""
193	        return list((read_json(self.audit_path(tenant), None) or {}).get("items") or [])
194	
195	    # -- runs ----------------------------------------------------------
196	    def save_run(self, run):
197	        atomic_write_json(self.run_path(run["tenant"], run["run_id"]), run)
198	        return run
199	
200	    def load_run(self, tenant, run_id):
201	        run = read_json(self.run_path(tenant, run_id), None)
202	        if run is None:
203	            raise WorkflowError("unknown run: %s" % run_id, "unknown_run")
204	        return normalize_run(run)
205	
206	    def run_exists(self, run_id):
207	        """Return the tenant owning ``run_id``, or ``None``."""
208	        for tenant in sorted(os.listdir(self.root)):
209	            if os.path.isfile(os.path.join(self.root, tenant, "runs", "%s.json" % run_id)):
210	                return tenant
211	        return None
212	
213	    def load_all_runs(self, tenant):
214	        """Return every run of the tenant as a list sorted by ``run_id``."""
215	        runs_dir = os.path.join(self.tenant_dir(tenant), "runs")
216	        items = []
217	        for name in sorted(os.listdir(runs_dir)) if os.path.isdir(runs_dir) else []:
218	            run = read_json(os.path.join(runs_dir, name), None) if name.endswith(".json") else None
219	            if run is not None:
220	                items.append(normalize_run(run))
221	        items.sort(key=lambda r: r.get("run_id", ""))
222	        return items
223	
224	    def list_runs(self, tenant, status=None, limit=50, after=None):
225	        runs_dir = os.path.join(self.tenant_dir(tenant), "runs")
226	        items = []
227	        for name in sorted(os.listdir(runs_dir)) if os.path.isdir(runs_dir) else []:
228	            run = read_json(os.path.join(runs_dir, name), None) if name.endswith(".json") else None
229	            if run is not None:
230	                items.append(normalize_run(run))
231	        items.sort(key=lambda r: (r.get("created_at", ""), r.get("run_id", "")))
232	        if status:
233	            items = [r for r in items if r.get("status") == status]
234	        if after:
235	            position = [i for i, r in enumerate(items) if r.get("run_id") == after]
236	            items = items[position[0] + 1:] if position else []
237	        limit = max(1, int(limit))
238	        page = items[:limit]
239	        return page, (page[-1]["run_id"] if len(items) > limit else None)
240	
241	
242	def normalize_run(run):
243	    """Backfill fields missing from documents written by older versions.
244	
245	    Steps without ``kind`` predate approval nodes and are ordinary tasks.
246	    Runs without ``max_parallelism`` predate per-run concurrency quotas and
247	    have no limit (``None``).  Runs without ``idempotency_key`` predate
248	    tenant-scoped idempotency keys and never participate in dedup (``None``).
249	    Runs without ``not_before`` predate delayed start and begin immediately
250	    (``None``).  Runs without ``schedule_id``/``scheduled_at`` predate
251	    periodic scheduling and were created manually (``None``).  Steps without
252	    ``next_attempt_at`` predate retry backoff and are immediately claimable
253	    (``None``).  Mutates and returns ``run``.
254	    """
255	    run.setdefault("max_parallelism", None)
256	    run.setdefault("idempotency_key", None)
257	    run.setdefault("not_before", None)
258	    run.setdefault("schedule_id", None)
259	    run.setdefault("scheduled_at", None)
260	    for step in run.get("steps", {}).values():
261	        step.setdefault("kind", KIND_TASK)
262	        step.setdefault("approval", None)
263	        step.setdefault("next_attempt_at", None)
264	    return run
265	
266	
267	def new_run(tenant, workflow_id, run_id, params, plan, now_iso, max_parallelism=None,
268	            idempotency_key=None, not_before=None, schedule_id=None, scheduled_at=None):
269	    """Build a fresh run document from a validated plan."""
270	    steps = {
271	        step["id"]: {
272	            "id": step["id"],
273	            "kind": step.get("kind", KIND_TASK),
274	            "depends_on": list(step["depends_on"]),
275	            "max_attempts": step["max_attempts"],
276	            "status": STEP_PENDING,
277	            "attempt": 0,
278	            "worker_id": None,
279	            "lease_deadline": None,
280	            "next_attempt_at": None,
281	            "ready_at": None,
282	            "started_at": None,
283	            "finished_at": None,
284	            "result": None,
285	            "error": None,
286	            "approval": None,
287	        }
288	        for step in plan["steps"]
289	    }
290	    return {
291	        "tenant": tenant,
292	        "workflow_id": workflow_id,
293	        "run_id": run_id,
294	        "status": RUN_PENDING,
295	        "params": params or {},
296	        "max_parallelism": max_parallelism,
297	        "idempotency_key": idempotency_key,
298	        "not_before": not_before,
299	        "schedule_id": schedule_id,
300	        "scheduled_at": scheduled_at,
301	        "created_at": now_iso,
302	        "updated_at": now_iso,
303	        "step_order": list(plan["order"]),
304	        "order_index": {sid: i for i, sid in enumerate(plan["order"])},
305	        "steps": steps,
306	        "history": [],
307	    }

1	"""Standard library HTTP API for flowd."""
2	
3	import json
4	import re
5	from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer
6	from urllib.parse import parse_qs, unquote, urlparse
7	
8	from .model import WorkflowError
9	from .scheduler import ConflictError, LeaseError
10	
11	MAX_BODY = 1 << 20
12	STATUS_FOR_CODE = {"unknown_run": 404, "unknown_workflow": 404, "unknown_step": 404,
13	                   "unknown_worker": 404, "unknown_schedule": 404,
14	                   "schedule_exists": 409, "cross_tenant": 403}
15	DECISIONS = ("approve", "reject")
16	
17	
18	class _Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
19	    protocol_version = "HTTP/1.1"
20	    server_version = "flowd/0.1"
21	
22	    def log_message(self, fmt, *args):  # keep the console quiet
23	        pass
24	
25	    # -- plumbing ------------------------------------------------------
26	    def _send(self, code, raw=b""):
27	        self.send_response(code)
28	        if code != 204:
29	            self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
30	        self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(raw)))
31	        self.end_headers()
32	        if raw:
33	            self.wfile.write(raw)
34	
35	    def _json(self, code, payload):
36	        self._send(code, json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=True, sort_keys=True).encode("utf-8"))
37	
38	    def _error(self, code, message):
39	        self._json(code, {"error": message})
40	
41	    def _body(self):
42	        length = int(self.headers.get("Content-Length") or 0)
43	        if length <= 0:
44	            return {}
45	        if length > MAX_BODY:
46	            raise WorkflowError("request body too large", "body_too_large")
47	        try:
48	            payload = json.loads(self.rfile.read(length).decode("utf-8"))
49	        except (ValueError, UnicodeDecodeError):
50	            raise WorkflowError("request body must be valid JSON", "bad_json")
51	        if not isinstance(payload, dict):
52	            raise WorkflowError("request body must be a JSON object", "bad_json")
53	        return payload
54	
55	    def _tenant(self, query, body=None):
56	        tenant = (body or {}).get("tenant") or (query.get("tenant") or [None])[0]
57	        if not tenant:
58	            raise WorkflowError("tenant is required", "bad_tenant")
59	        return tenant
60	    # -- verbs ---------------------------------------------------------
61	    def do_GET(self):
62	        self._dispatch("GET")
63	
64	    def do_POST(self):
65	        self._dispatch("POST")
66	
67	    def _dispatch(self, method):
68	        parsed = urlparse(self.path)
69	        path = parsed.path.rstrip("/") or "/"
70	        try:
71	            self._route(method, path, parse_qs(parsed.query), parsed.query)
72	        except LeaseError as exc:
73	            self._error(409, exc.message)
74	        except ConflictError as exc:
75	            self._error(409, exc.message)
76	        except WorkflowError as exc:
77	            self._error(STATUS_FOR_CODE.get(exc.code, 400), exc.message)
78	        except Exception as exc:  # pragma: no cover - defensive
79	            self._error(500, "internal error: %s" % exc)
80	
81	    def _route(self, method, path, query, raw_query=""):
82	        body = {}
83	        if method == "GET":
84	            if path == "/healthz":
85	                return self._json(200, {"ok": True})
86	            if path == "/v1/runs":
87	                return self._list_runs(query)
88	            if path == "/v1/schedules":
89	                return self._list_schedules(query)
90	            if path == "/v1/workers":
91	                return self._list_workers(query)
92	            if path == "/v1/audit":
93	                # Blank values count as "provided" here: an empty tenant,
94	                # action or run_id is a 400, not a missing parameter.
95	                return self._list_audit(parse_qs(raw_query, keep_blank_values=True))
96	        elif method == "POST":
97	            if path == "/v1/tasks/claim":
98	                return self._claim_any_task(self._body())
99	            if path == "/v1/workers/register":
100	                return self._register_worker(self._body())
101	            worker_beat = re.fullmatch(r"/v1/workers/([^/]+)/heartbeat", path)
102	            if worker_beat:
103	                return self._worker_heartbeat(unquote(worker_beat.group(1)), self._body())
104	            if path == "/v1/workflows":
105	                body = self._body()
106	                tenant = self._tenant({}, body)
107	                plan = self.scheduler.submit(tenant, body.get("workflow_id"), body.get("steps"))
108	                return self._json(201, dict(plan, tenant=tenant))
109	            if path == "/v1/runs":
110	                body = self._body()
111	                run = self.scheduler.start_run(self._tenant({}, body), body.get("workflow_id"),
112	                                               body.get("run_id"), body.get("params"),
113	                                               body.get("max_parallelism"),
114	                                               body.get("idempotency_key"),
115	                                               body.get("not_before"))
116	                return self._json(201, _run_view(run))
117	            if path == "/v1/schedules":
118	                return self._create_schedule(self._body())
119	            schedule_dispatch = re.fullmatch(r"/v1/schedules/([^/]+)/dispatch", path)
120	            if schedule_dispatch:
121	                return self._dispatch_schedule(unquote(schedule_dispatch.group(1)), self._body())
122	            action = re.fullmatch(r"/v1/runs/([^/]+)/(claim|complete|fail|decision|heartbeat)", path)
123	            if action:
124	                if action.group(2) == "decision":
125	                    return self._decision(action.group(1), self._body())
126	                if action.group(2) == "heartbeat":
127	                    return self._heartbeat(action.group(1), self._body())
128	                return self._step_action(action.group(1), action.group(2), self._body())
129	        solo = re.fullmatch(r"/v1/runs/([^/]+)", path)
130	        if method == "GET" and solo:
131	            return self._get_run(query, solo.group(1))
132	        return self._error(404, "no route for %s %s" % (method, path))
133	
134	    # -- handlers ------------------------------------------------------
135	    def _get_run(self, query, run_id):
136	        tenant = self._tenant(query)
137	        owner = self.scheduler.store.run_exists(run_id)
138	        if owner is not None and owner != tenant:
139	            raise WorkflowError("run %s belongs to another tenant" % run_id, "cross_tenant")
140	        return self._json(200, _run_view(self.scheduler.get_run(tenant, run_id)))
141	
142	    def _list_runs(self, query):
143	        tenant = self._tenant(query)
144	        items, next_after = self.scheduler.list_runs(
145	            tenant,
146	            status=(query.get("status") or [None])[0],
147	            limit=int((query.get("limit") or ["50"])[0]),
148	            after=(query.get("after") or [None])[0],
149	        )
150	        return self._json(200, {"tenant": tenant, "items": [_run_view(r) for r in items],
151	                                "next_after": next_after})
152	
153	    # -- audit stream ----------------------------------------------------
154	    @staticmethod
155	    def _query_int(query, name, default, code):
156	        raw = (query.get(name) or [None])[0]
157	        if raw is None:
158	            return default
159	        try:
160	            return int(raw, 10)
161	        except ValueError:
162	            raise WorkflowError("%s must be an integer" % name, code)
163	
164	    def _list_audit(self, query):
165	        tenant = (query.get("tenant") or [None])[0]
166	        if not isinstance(tenant, str) or not tenant.strip():
167	            raise WorkflowError("tenant must be a non-empty string", "bad_tenant")
168	        limit = self._query_int(query, "limit", 100, "bad_limit")
169	        if not 1 <= limit <= 1000:
170	            raise WorkflowError("limit must be an integer between 1 and 1000", "bad_limit")
171	        after = self._query_int(query, "after", 0, "bad_after")
172	        if after < 0:
173	            raise WorkflowError("after must be a non-negative integer", "bad_after")
174	        action = (query.get("action") or [None])[0]
175	        if action is not None and not action.strip():
176	            raise WorkflowError("action must be a non-empty string", "bad_action")
177	        run_id = (query.get("run_id") or [None])[0]
178	        if run_id is not None and not run_id.strip():
179	            raise WorkflowError("run_id must be a non-empty string", "bad_run_id")
180	        items, next_after = self.scheduler.list_audit(
181	            tenant, action=action, run_id=run_id, limit=limit, after=after)
182	        return self._json(200, {"tenant": tenant.strip(), "items": items,
183	                                "next_after": next_after})
184	
185	    # -- periodic schedules -------------------------------------------
186	    def _create_schedule(self, body):
187	        record = self.scheduler.create_schedule(
188	            self._tenant({}, body), body.get("schedule_id"), body.get("workflow_id"),
189	            body.get("interval_seconds"), body.get("first_at"), body.get("params"),
190	            body.get("max_parallelism"),
191	        )
192	        return self._json(201, _schedule_view(record))
193	
194	    def _list_schedules(self, query):
195	        tenant = self._tenant(query)
196	        return self._json(200, {"tenant": tenant,
197	                                "items": [_schedule_view(r)
198	                                          for r in self.scheduler.list_schedules(tenant)]})
199	
200	    def _dispatch_schedule(self, schedule_id, body):
201	        run, scheduled_at = self.scheduler.dispatch_schedule(self._tenant({}, body),
202	                                                              schedule_id)
203	        if run is None:
204	            return self._send(204)
205	        return self._json(201, _run_view(run, scheduled_at=scheduled_at))
206	
207	    # -- worker registry -----------------------------------------------
208	    def _worker_lease(self, body):
209	        """Extract lease_seconds: omitted defaults to 30, explicit null is 400."""
210	        if "lease_seconds" not in body:
211	            return 30
212	        lease = body["lease_seconds"]
213	        if lease is None:
214	            raise WorkflowError("lease_seconds must be a positive number", "bad_lease")
215	        return lease
216	
217	    def _register_worker(self, body):
218	        record, created = self.scheduler.register_worker(
219	            body.get("tenant"), body.get("worker_id"), self._worker_lease(body)
220	        )
221	        return self._json(201 if created else 200, record)
222	
223	    def _worker_heartbeat(self, worker_id, body):
224	        record = self.scheduler.heartbeat_worker(
225	            body.get("tenant"), worker_id, self._worker_lease(body)
226	        )
227	        return self._json(200, record)
228	
229	    def _list_workers(self, query):
230	        tenant = self._tenant(query)
231	        return self._json(200, {"tenant": tenant,
232	                                "items": self.scheduler.list_workers(tenant)})
233	
234	    def _claim_any_task(self, body):
235	        """Tenant-wide fair claim: 200 {"run_id","step"} or 204 when idle."""
236	        lease = body.get("lease_seconds", 30)
237	        if lease is None:
238	            raise WorkflowError("lease_seconds must be a positive number", "bad_lease")
239	        result = self.scheduler.claim_fair(body.get("tenant"), body.get("worker_id"), lease)
240	        if result is None:
241	            return self._send(204)
242	        run_id, step = result
243	        return self._json(200, {"run_id": run_id, "step": _step_view(step)})
244	
245	    def _step_action(self, run_id, action, body):
246	        tenant, worker_id = self._tenant({}, body), body.get("worker_id")
247	        if action == "claim":
248	            step = self.scheduler.claim(tenant, run_id, worker_id, body.get("lease_seconds", 30))
249	            return self._send(204) if step is None else self._json(200, {"step": _step_view(step)})
250	        if action == "complete":
251	            run = self.scheduler.complete(tenant, run_id, body.get("step_id"), worker_id,
252	                                          body.get("result"))
253	        else:
254	            run = self.scheduler.fail(tenant, run_id, body.get("step_id"), worker_id,
255	                                      body.get("error"))
256	        return self._json(200, _run_view(run))
257	
258	    def _heartbeat(self, run_id, body):
259	        """Renew a lease; strict field validation, anything bad is a 400."""
260	        for name in ("tenant", "step_id", "worker_id"):
261	            value = body.get(name)
262	            if not isinstance(value, str) or not value.strip():
263	                raise WorkflowError("%s must be a non-empty string" % name, "bad_%s" % name)
264	        run = self.scheduler.heartbeat(body["tenant"], run_id, body["step_id"],
265	                                       body["worker_id"], body.get("lease_seconds", 30))
266	        return self._json(200, _run_view(run))
267	
268	    def _decision(self, run_id, body):
269	        """Validate strictly; any missing/blank/wrong-type field is a 400."""
270	        fields = {}
271	        for name in ("tenant", "step_id", "actor"):
272	            value = body.get(name)
273	            if not isinstance(value, str) or not value.strip():
274	                raise WorkflowError("%s must be a non-empty string" % name, "bad_%s" % name)
275	            fields[name] = value.strip()
276	        decision = body.get("decision")
277	        if decision not in DECISIONS:
278	            raise WorkflowError("decision must be one of %s" % ", ".join(DECISIONS),
279	                                "bad_decision")
280	        tenant = fields["tenant"]
281	        owner = self.scheduler.store.run_exists(run_id)
282	        if owner is not None and owner != tenant:
283	            raise WorkflowError("run %s belongs to another tenant" % run_id, "cross_tenant")
284	        run = self.scheduler.decide(tenant, run_id, fields["step_id"], fields["actor"], decision)
285	        return self._json(200, _run_view(run))
286	
287	
288	def _step_view(step):
289	    return {"id": step["id"], "kind": step.get("kind", "task"), "status": step["status"],
290	            "attempt": step["attempt"],
291	            "max_attempts": step["max_attempts"], "depends_on": list(step["depends_on"]),
292	            "worker_id": step["worker_id"], "lease_deadline": step["lease_deadline"],
293	            "next_attempt_at": step["next_attempt_at"], "result": step.get("result"),
294	            "error": step.get("error"), "approval": step.get("approval")}
295	
296	
297	def _schedule_view(record):
298	    return {"tenant": record["tenant"], "schedule_id": record["schedule_id"],
299	            "workflow_id": record["workflow_id"],
300	            "interval_seconds": record["interval_seconds"],
301	            "first_at": record.get("first_at"), "next_at": record.get("next_at"),
302	            "params": record.get("params") or {},
303	            "max_parallelism": record.get("max_parallelism"),
304	            "created_at": record.get("created_at"), "updated_at": record.get("updated_at")}
305	
306	
307	def _run_view(run, scheduled_at=None):
308	    if scheduled_at is None:
309	        scheduled_at = run.get("scheduled_at")

def test_backoff_formula(self):
        self.assertEqual([backoff_seconds(n) for n in (1, 2, 3, 4)], [1.0, 2.0, 4.0, 8.0])
        self.assertEqual(backoff_seconds(3, base=0.5), 2.0)

    def test_fail_after_exhaustion_marks_run_failed(self):
        self.workflow("one", [{"id": "s", "depends_on": [], "max_attempts": 1}])
        run = self.scheduler.start_run("acme", "one")
        self.claim(run["run_id"])
        run = self.scheduler.fail("acme", run["run_id"], "s", "w1", "boom")
        self.assertEqual((run["status"], run["steps"]["s"]["status"]), ("failed", "failed"))

    def test_replay_matches_stored_state_after_retries(self):
        self.workflow("flaky", [{"id": "s", "depends_on": [], "max_attempts": 3}])
        run = self.scheduler.start_run("acme", "flaky")
        self.claim(run["run_id"])
        self.scheduler.fail("acme", run["run_id"], "s", "w1", "boom")
        self.clock.advance(1)  # wait out the backoff before re-claiming
        self.claim(run["run_id"])
        stored = self.complete(run["run_id"], "s", result={"ok": True})
        replayed = self.scheduler.replay("acme", run["run_id"])
        self.assertEqual(replayed["status"], stored["status"])
        self.assertEqual((replayed["steps"]["s"]["status"], replayed["steps"]["s"]["attempt"]),
                         ("succeeded", 2))

    def test_replay_and_restart_restore_pending_retry_schedule(self):
        self.workflow("flaky", [{"id": "s", "depends_on": [], "max_attempts": 3}])
        run = self.scheduler.start_run("acme", "flaky")
        run_id = run["run_id"]
        self.claim(run_id)
        stored = self.scheduler.fail("acme", run_id, "s", "w1", "boom")
        replayed = self.scheduler.replay("acme", run_id)
        step, rebuilt = stored["steps"]["s"], replayed["steps"]["s"]
        self.assertEqual((rebuilt["status"], rebuilt["attempt"]),
                         (step["status"], step["attempt"]))
        self.assertEqual(rebuilt["next_attempt_at"], step["next_attempt_at"])
        self.assertEqual(rebuilt["ready_at"], step["ready_at"])
        # A fresh scheduler over the same data directory gates claims on the
        # persisted backoff exactly like the original one.
        fresh = Scheduler(WorkflowStore(self.root, clock=self.clock),
                          clock=self.clock, backoff_base=1.0)
        self.assertIsNone(fresh.claim("acme", run_id, "w2"))
        self.clock.advance(1)
        self.assertEqual(fresh.claim("acme", run_id, "w2")["id"], "s")

        self.workflow()
        run = self.scheduler.start_run("acme", "etl")
        self.assertEqual(self.claim(run["run_id"], "w1", lease=5)["id"], "step1")
        self.assertIsNone(self.claim(run["run_id"], "w2", lease=5))

        self.clock.advance(6)
        taken = self.claim(run["run_id"], "w2", lease=5)
        self.assertEqual((taken["id"], taken["worker_id"]), ("step1", "w2"))
        events = self.scheduler.history(run["run_id"], "acme")
        takeovers = [e for e in events if e["type"] == "takeover"]
        self.assertEqual(len(takeovers), 1)
        self.assertEqual(takeovers[0]["worker_id"], "w1")
        self.assertEqual(events[-1]["type"], "claim")

        self.claim(run["run_id"], "w1", lease=10)
        self.assertIsNone(self.claim(run["run_id"], "w1", lease=10))
        self.clock.advance(10)  # deadline reached -> expired

        stated = self.scheduler.get_run("acme", run["run_id"])
        replayed = self.scheduler.replay("acme", run["run_id"])
        self.assertEqual(replayed["status"], stated["status"])

        self.assertEqual(second[: len(first)], first)

"""Tests for delayed run start (``not_before``).

A run created with a future ``not_before`` (UTC Unix seconds) stays fully
``pending`` until the first ``claim`` arrives at or after that time.  The
scheduled time is part of the run document and the idempotency match, and it
survives replay and restart.
"""

import io
import json
import os
import shutil
import tempfile
import time
import unittest
from contextlib import redirect_stdout

from flowd.cli import main
from flowd.model import WorkflowError
from flowd.scheduler import ConflictError, Scheduler
from flowd.store import WorkflowStore, atomic_write_json

LINEAR = [
    {"id": "step1", "depends_on": []},
    {"id": "step2", "depends_on": ["step1"]},
    {"id": "step3", "depends_on": ["step2"]},
]
FAN_TASKS = [{"id": "a", "depends_on": []}, {"id": "b", "depends_on": []}]
SOLO_APPROVAL = [{"id": "g", "depends_on": [], "kind": "approval"}]
MIXED_ROOTS = [{"id": "t", "depends_on": []}, {"id": "g", "depends_on": [], "kind": "approval"}]


class FakeClock:
    def __init__(self, start=1_700_000_000.0):
        self.value = float(start)

    def __call__(self):
        return self.value

    def advance(self, seconds):
        self.value += float(seconds)
        return self.value


class DelayedStartTestBase(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.root = tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="flowd-delay-")
        self.addCleanup(shutil.rmtree, self.root, True)
        self.clock = FakeClock()
        self.store = WorkflowStore(self.root, clock=self.clock)
        self.scheduler = Scheduler(self.store, clock=self.clock)

    def submit(self, steps=None, workflow_id="wf", tenant="acme"):
        return self.scheduler.submit(tenant, workflow_id, steps or LINEAR)

    def start(self, not_before="OMIT", run_id="r1", workflow_id="wf", tenant="acme",
              idempotency_key="OMIT", **kwargs):
        params = {"tenant": tenant, "workflow_id": workflow_id, "run_id": run_id}
        params.update(kwargs)
        if not_before != "OMIT":
            params["not_before"] = not_before
        if idempotency_key != "OMIT":
            params["idempotency_key"] = idempotency_key
        return self.scheduler.start_run(**params)

    def claim(self, run_id="r1", worker="w1", lease=30, tenant="acme"):
        return self.scheduler.claim(tenant, run_id, worker, lease)

    def history_types(self, run_id="r1"):
        return [e["type"] for e in self.scheduler.history(run_id, "acme")]


class NotBeforeValidationTest(DelayedStartTestBase):
    def test_none_and_omitted_mean_immediate(self):
        self.submit()
        omitted = self.start()
        explicit = self.start(run_id="r2", not_before=None)
        self.assertIsNone(omitted["not_before"])
        self.assertIsNone(explicit["not_before"])
        # roots open immediately
        self.assertEqual([s["status"] for s in omitted["steps"].values()],
                         ["ready", "pending", "pending"])

    def test_ints_and_floats_accepted_and_stored_as_number(self):
        self.submit()
        run = self.start(not_before=self.clock() + 60)
        self.assertEqual(run["not_before"], self.clock() + 60)
        runf = self.start(run_id="r2", not_before=self.clock() + 1.5)
        self.assertEqual(runf["not_before"], self.clock() + 1.5)

    def test_bad_values_raise_bad_not_before_and_create_nothing(self):
        self.submit()
        for bad in (True, False, "1700000060", -1, -0.5, float("inf"), float("-inf"),
                    float("nan"), [], {}, [10], 10 ** 400):
            with self.assertRaises(WorkflowError) as ctx:
                self.start(run_id="bad-%r" % (bad,), not_before=bad)
            self.assertEqual(ctx.exception.code, "bad_not_before", repr(bad))
        self.assertEqual(self.scheduler.list_runs("acme")[0], [])

    def test_existing_field_validation_order_is_unchanged(self):
        # bad idempotency key beats bad quota, bad params and bad not_before
        with self.assertRaises(WorkflowError) as ctx:
            self.scheduler.start_run("acme", "wf", run_id="x", max_parallelism=0,
                                     idempotency_key=9, params=[1], not_before=-1)
        self.assertEqual(ctx.exception.code, "bad_idempotency_key")
        self.submit()
        # then bad quota
        with self.assertRaises(WorkflowError) as ctx:
            self.scheduler.start_run("acme", "wf", run_id="x", max_parallelism=0,
                                     idempotency_key="k", params=[1], not_before=-1)
        self.assertEqual(ctx.exception.code, "bad_max_parallelism")
        # then bad params (only validated for keyed creates)
        with self.assertRaises(WorkflowError) as ctx:
            self.scheduler.start_run("acme", "wf", run_id="x", idempotency_key="k",
                                     params=[1], not_before=-1)
        self.assertEqual(ctx.exception.code, "bad_params")
        # then bad not_before, before the workflow lookup / binding match
        with self.assertRaises(WorkflowError) as ctx:
            self.scheduler.start_run("acme", "ghost", run_id="x", idempotency_key="k",
                                     params={}, not_before=-1)
        self.assertEqual(ctx.exception.code, "bad_not_before")
        self.assertEqual(self.scheduler.list_runs("acme")[0], [])

    def test_past_or_present_time_starts_immediately(self):
        self.submit()
        past = self.start(run_id="r1", not_before=self.clock() - 10)
        self.assertEqual(past["not_before"], self.clock() - 10)
        self.assertEqual([s["status"] for s in past["steps"].values()],
                         ["ready", "pending", "pending"])
        equal = self.start(run_id="r2", not_before=self.clock())
        self.assertEqual([s["status"] for s in equal["steps"].values()],
                         ["ready", "pending", "pending"])

    def test_future_run_keeps_every_node_pending(self):
        self.submit(FAN_TASKS)
        run = self.start(not_before=self.clock() + 60)
        self.assertEqual(run["status"], "pending")
        for step in run["steps"].values():
            self.assertEqual(step["status"], "pending")
            self.assertEqual(step["attempt"], 0)
            self.assertIsNone(step["worker_id"])
            self.assertIsNone(step["lease_deadline"])
            self.assertIsNone(step["ready_at"])
        self.assertEqual(self.history_types(), ["run_created"])

    def test_future_approval_roots_are_not_waiting(self):
        self.submit(MIXED_ROOTS)
        run = self.start(not_before=self.clock() + 60)
        self.assertEqual(run["steps"]["t"]["status"], "pending")
        self.assertEqual(run["steps"]["g"]["status"], "pending")
        self.assertIsNone(run["steps"]["g"]["approval"])

    def test_not_before_reported_on_detail_and_listing(self):
        self.submit()
        when = self.clock() + 60
        self.start(not_before=when)
        self.assertEqual(self.scheduler.get_run("acme", "r1")["not_before"], when)
        items, _ = self.scheduler.list_runs("acme")
        self.assertEqual(items[0]["not_before"], when)

    def test_old_run_without_field_reads_as_null(self):
        self.submit()
        run = self.start(run_id="old")
        path = os.path.join(self.root, "acme", "runs", "old.json")
        with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
            doc = json.load(handle)
        del doc["not_before"]
        atomic_write_json(path, doc)
        self.assertIsNone(self.scheduler.get_run("acme", "old")["not_before"])
        self.assertIsNone(self.scheduler.replay("acme", "old")["not_before"])


class ClaimActivationTest(DelayedStartTestBase):
    def test_claim_before_due_returns_none_and_changes_nothing(self):
        self.submit(FAN_TASKS)
        run = self.start(not_before=self.clock() + 60)
        before = self.scheduler.get_run("acme", "r1")
        for _ in range(3):
            self.assertIsNone(self.claim(worker="w1"))
            self.assertIsNone(self.claim(worker="w2"))
        after = self.scheduler.get_run("acme", "r1")
        self.assertEqual(after, before)
        self.assertEqual(after["updated_at"], run["updated_at"])
        self.assertEqual(self.history_types(), ["run_created"])

    def test_claim_at_or_after_due_activates_roots_and_leases_one_task(self):
        self.submit(FAN_TASKS)
        when = self.clock() + 60
        self.start(not_before=when)
        self.clock.advance(60)  # not_before == now -> due
        step = self.claim()
        self.assertEqual(step["id"], "a")
        run = self.scheduler.get_run("acme", "r1")
        self.assertEqual(run["steps"]["a"]["status"], "running")
        self.assertEqual(run["steps"]["b"]["status"], "ready")
        types = self.history_types()
        ready_ids = [e["step_id"] for e in self.scheduler.history("r1", "acme")
                     if e["type"] == "ready"]
        self.assertEqual(ready_ids, ["a", "b"])
        self.assertIn("run_started", types)
        self.assertEqual(run["status"], "running")

    def test_activation_opens_each_root_exactly_once(self):
        self.submit(FAN_TASKS)

    def test_approval_only_run_activates_and_returns_no_task(self):

        self.assertIsNone(self.claim())

        self.assertEqual(run["steps"]["g"]["status"], "waiting")
        self.assertEqual(run["status"], "pending")
        self.assertEqual(self.history_types(), ["run_created", "waiting"])
        # a second claim does not record a second waiting event
        self.assertIsNone(self.claim())
        self.assertEqual(self.history_types(), ["run_created", "waiting"])

    def test_mixed_roots_record_ready_and_waiting_on_activation(self):
        self.submit(MIXED_ROOTS)

        self.assertEqual(self.claim()["id"], "t")
        run = self.scheduler.get_run("acme", "r1")
        self.assertEqual(run["steps"]["g"]["status"], "waiting")
        self.assertEqual(self.history_types().count("waiting"), 1)
        self.assertEqual(self.history_types().count("ready"), 1)

    def test_quota_is_not_consumed_before_activation(self):

                         max_parallelism=1)

        # the delayed run must not be occupying anything
        self.assertEqual([s["status"] for s in run["steps"].values()], ["pending", "pending"])
        self.clock.advance(60)
        self.assertEqual(self.claim(run_id="q")["id"], "a")
        self.assertIsNone(self.claim(run_id="q", worker="w2"))

    def test_query_listing_and_repeat_create_do_not_activate_even_when_due(self):
        self.submit()

        self.clock.advance(90)
        self.assertEqual(self.scheduler.get_run("acme", "r1")["steps"]["step1"]["status"],
                         "pending")
        self.assertEqual(self.scheduler.list_runs("acme")[0][0]["steps"]["step1"]["status"],
                         "pending")
        repeat = self.scheduler.start_run("acme", "wf", run_id="r1", idempotency_key="k",
                                          not_before=keyed["not_before"])
        self.assertEqual(repeat["steps"]["step1"]["status"], "pending")
        self.assertEqual(self.history_types(), ["run_created"])
        # the first claim is what activates
        self.assertEqual(self.claim()["id"], "step1")

        self.clock.advance(90)

    def test_replay_matches_stored_state_through_heartbeat_and_takeover(self):
        self.clock.advance(10)
        self.heartbeat(lease=100)
        stored = self.scheduler.get_run("acme", self.run_id)
        replayed = self.scheduler.replay("acme", self.run_id)
        for doc in (replayed, stored):
            self.assertEqual(doc["status"], "running")
        step = replayed["steps"]["step1"]
        self.assertEqual((step["worker_id"], step["lease_deadline"], step["attempt"]),
                         ("w1", stored["steps"]["step1"]["lease_deadline"], 0))
        self.clock.advance(200)  # extended lease expires, w2 takes over
        taken = self.claim(self.run_id, "w2", lease=15)
        self.assertEqual(taken["worker_id"], "w2")
        stored = self.scheduler.get_run("acme", self.run_id)
        replayed = self.scheduler.replay("acme", self.run_id)
        for doc in (replayed, stored):
            step = doc["steps"]["step1"]
            self.assertEqual((step["status"], step["worker_id"],
                              step["lease_deadline"], step["attempt"]),
                             ("running", "w2", self.clock.value + 15, 0))

    def test_heartbeat_survives_a_fresh_store(self):
        self.clock.advance(10)
        self.heartbeat(lease=90)
        restarted = Scheduler(WorkflowStore(self.root, clock=self.clock), clock=self.clock)
        step = restarted.get_run("acme", self.run_id)["steps"]["step1"]
        self.assertEqual(step["lease_deadline"], self.clock.value + 90)
        self.clock.advance(50)  # original 30s deadline gone, renewal still holds
        self.assertIsNone(restarted.claim("acme", self.run_id, "w2", 5))

def normalize_run(run):
    """Backfill fields missing from documents written by older versions.

    Steps without ``kind`` predate approval nodes and are ordinary tasks.
    Runs without ``max_parallelism`` predate per-run concurrency quotas and
    have no limit (``None``).  Runs without ``idempotency_key`` predate
    tenant-scoped idempotency keys and never participate in dedup (``None``).
    Runs without ``not_before`` predate delayed start and begin immediately
    (``None``).  Runs without ``schedule_id``/``scheduled_at`` predate
    periodic scheduling and were created manually (``None``).  Steps without
    ``next_attempt_at`` predate retry backoff and are immediately claimable
    (``None``).  Mutates and returns ``run``.
    """
    run.setdefault("max_parallelism", None)
    run.setdefault("idempotency_key", None)
    run.setdefault("not_before", None)
    run.setdefault("schedule_id", None)
    run.setdefault("scheduled_at", None)
    for step in run.get("steps", {}).values():
        step.setdefault("kind", KIND_TASK)
        step.setdefault("approval", None)
        step.setdefault("next_attempt_at", None)
    return run

def normalize_run(run):
    """Backfill fields missing from documents written by older versions.

    Steps without ``kind`` predate approval nodes and are ordinary tasks.
    Runs without ``max_parallelism`` predate per-run concurrency quotas and
    have no limit (``None``).  Runs without ``idempotency_key`` predate
    tenant-scoped idempotency keys and never participate in dedup (``None``).
    Runs without ``not_before`` predate delayed start and begin immediately
    (``None``).  Runs without ``schedule_id``/``scheduled_at`` predate
    periodic scheduling and were created manually (``None``).  Steps without
    ``next_attempt_at`` predate retry backoff and are immediately claimable
    (``None``).  Runs without a frozen ``plan`` predate per-run DAG snapshots
    and reconstruct theirs from the node definitions and ``step_order`` saved
    in the run document itself, so replay never has to read the workflow
    registry (which a later same-name submission may have overwritten).
    Mutates and returns ``run``.
    """
    run.setdefault("max_parallelism", None)
    run.setdefault("idempotency_key", None)
    run.setdefault("not_before", None)
    run.setdefault("schedule_id", None)
    run.setdefault("scheduled_at", None)
    for step in run.get("steps", {}).values():
        step.setdefault("kind", KIND_TASK)
        step.setdefault("approval", None)
        step.setdefault("next_attempt_at", None)
    if not run.get("plan"):
        run["plan"] = plan_from_run(run)
    return run


def plan_from_run(run):
    """Reconstruct a normalized plan from the definitions frozen in a run.

    The run document keeps each node's ``kind``, ``depends_on`` and
    ``max_attempts`` together with ``step_order``; those are exactly the
    fields a plan needs, so documents written before plans were snapshotted
    remain replayable even after the workflow of the same id is overwritten
    or deleted.
    """
    steps = run.get("steps") or {}
    order = [sid for sid in (run.get("step_order") or sorted(steps)) if sid in steps]
    ordered = [
        {
            "id": steps[sid]["id"],
            "depends_on": list(steps[sid].get("depends_on") or []),
            "max_attempts": steps[sid]["max_attempts"],
            "kind": steps[sid].get("kind", KIND_TASK),
        }
        for sid in order
    ]
    return {
        "workflow_id": run.get("workflow_id"),
        "steps": ordered,
        "order": [step["id"] for step in ordered],
    }


def run_plan(run):
    """Return the normalized DAG plan frozen into ``run`` at creation.

    Newer documents carry an explicit snapshot under ``plan``; older ones
    reconstruct it via :func:`plan_from_run` from the run's own nodes and
    ordering.  The result is a fresh copy, so callers can never mutate the
    snapshot stored in the run document.
    """
    snapshot = run.get("plan")
    if not snapshot or not snapshot.get("steps"):
        snapshot = plan_from_run(run)
    return {
        "workflow_id": snapshot.get("workflow_id", run.get("workflow_id")),
        "steps": [dict(step) for step in snapshot.get("steps", [])],
        "order": list(snapshot.get("order", [])),
    }

# -- history / replay ----------------------------------------------
    def replay(self, tenant, run_id):
        """Rebuild run state from the run's frozen definition and history.

        Nodes are rebuilt from the normalized DAG snapshotted into the run
        document at creation time, never from the workflow currently stored
        under the run's ``workflow_id``: a later same-name submission may
        replace that workflow, but existing runs keep their original step
        order, node kinds, dependencies, ``max_attempts`` and state-machine
        semantics.  Documents written before snapshots existed reconstruct
        the plan from the definitions and order saved in the run itself.

        The result agrees with the persisted run on every observable field —
        ``run_id``, ``workflow_id``, ``step_order``, run and per-step
        ``status``, ``attempt``, ``worker_id``, ``lease_deadline``,
        ``next_attempt_at``, ``ready_at``, ``started_at``, ``finished_at``,
        ``result``, ``error`` and ``approval`` — and the append-only history
        is the sole source of transitions, so replaying again, including
        after a restart, yields the identical document.
        """
        stored = self.get_run(tenant, run_id)
        plan = run_plan(stored)
        rebuilt = new_run(tenant, stored["workflow_id"], run_id, stored.get("params"), plan,
                          stored["created_at"],
                          max_parallelism=stored.get("max_parallelism"),
                          idempotency_key=stored.get("idempotency_key"),
                          not_before=stored.get("not_before"),
                          schedule_id=stored.get("schedule_id"),
                          scheduled_at=stored.get("scheduled_at"))
        # The fresh document must carry exactly the frozen snapshot and
        # ordering of the stored run (new_run fills them from the same plan
        # already, but align them defensively for reconstructed old plans).
        rebuilt["plan"] = copy.deepcopy(plan)
        rebuilt["step_order"] = list(plan["order"])
        rebuilt["order_index"] = {sid: i for i, sid in enumerate(plan["order"])}
        steps = rebuilt["steps"]
        for event in stored["history"]:
            sid, etype, at = event.get("step_id"), event.get("type"), event.get("at")
            attempt = event.get("attempt")
            if sid is None:
                if etype == "run_succeeded":
                    rebuilt["status"] = RUN_SUCCEEDED
                elif etype == "run_failed":
                    rebuilt["status"] = RUN_FAILED
                elif etype == "run_started" and rebuilt["status"] == RUN_PENDING:
                    rebuilt["status"] = RUN_RUNNING
                continue
            step = steps.get(sid)
            if step is None:
                # The frozen definition has no node for this event: a node
                # introduced by a later same-name workflow must not appear
                # here, and old events can never reference a removed node.
                continue
            if etype == "ready":
                step.update(status=STEP_READY, ready_at=at)
            elif etype == "waiting":
                step.update(status=STEP_WAITING)
            elif etype == "claim":
                step.update(status=STEP_RUNNING, worker_id=event.get("worker_id"),
                            started_at=at, lease_deadline=event.get("lease_deadline"),
                            ready_at=None, next_attempt_at=None)
            elif etype == "heartbeat":
                step["lease_deadline"] = event.get("lease_deadline")
            elif etype == "takeover":
                # Mirrors _expire_leases: the node is re-queued and becomes
                # immediately claimable again, with a fresh ready_at.
                step.update(status=STEP_READY, worker_id=None, lease_deadline=None,
                            ready_at=at, started_at=None)
            elif etype == "complete":
                # Mirrors complete(): the successful node keeps the worker
                # that completed it and clears any prior failure error.
                step.update(status=STEP_SUCCEEDED, result=event.get("result"), error=None,
                            finished_at=at, lease_deadline=None,
                            worker_id=event.get("worker_id"),
                            next_attempt_at=None,
                            attempt=step["attempt"] if attempt is None else attempt)
            elif etype == "decision":
                approved = event.get("decision") == "approve"
                step.update(status=STEP_SUCCEEDED if approved else STEP_FAILED,
                            finished_at=at, worker_id=None, lease_deadline=None,
                            next_attempt_at=None,
                            approval={"actor": event.get("actor"),
                                      "decision": event.get("decision"), "at": at})
            elif etype == "fail":
                step.update(error=event.get("error"), worker_id=None, lease_deadline=None,
                            next_attempt_at=None,
                            attempt=step["attempt"] if attempt is None else attempt)
            elif etype == "retry":
                step.update(status=STEP_READY, ready_at=at,
                            next_attempt_at=event.get("next_attempt_at"),
                            started_at=None)
            elif etype == "attempts_exhausted":
                step.update(status=STEP_FAILED, finished_at=at, next_attempt_at=None,
                            started_at=None)
        if all(s["status"] == STEP_SUCCEEDED for s in steps.values()):
            rebuilt["status"] = RUN_SUCCEEDED
        elif any(s["status"] == STEP_FAILED for s in steps.values()):
            rebuilt["status"] = RUN_FAILED
        rebuilt["updated_at"] = stored.get("updated_at")
        rebuilt["history"] = copy.deepcopy(stored["history"])
        return rebuilt

"""Tests for tenant-scoped idempotent run creation (``idempotency_key``)."""

import io
import json
import os
import shutil
import tempfile
import threading
import unittest
from contextlib import redirect_stdout

from flowd.cli import main
from flowd.model import WorkflowError
from flowd.scheduler import ConflictError, Scheduler
from flowd.store import WorkflowStore, atomic_write_json

LINEAR = [
    {"id": "step1", "depends_on": []},
    {"id": "step2", "depends_on": ["step1"]},
    {"id": "step3", "depends_on": ["step2"]},
]

SOLO = [{"id": "solo", "depends_on": []}]


class IdempotencyTestBase(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.root = tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="flowd-idem-")
        self.addCleanup(shutil.rmtree, self.root, True)
        self.store = WorkflowStore(self.root)
        self.scheduler = Scheduler(self.store)

    def submit(self, tenant="acme", workflow_id="etl", steps=None):
        return self.scheduler.submit(tenant, workflow_id, steps or LINEAR)

    def start(self, tenant="acme", workflow_id="etl", run_id=None, params=None,
              max_parallelism=None, idempotency_key="NOTSET"):
        kwargs = {"run_id": run_id, "params": params, "max_parallelism": max_parallelism}
        if idempotency_key != "NOTSET":
            kwargs["idempotency_key"] = idempotency_key
        return self.scheduler.start_run(tenant, workflow_id, **kwargs)

    def restart(self):
        return Scheduler(WorkflowStore(self.root))


class KeyValidationTest(IdempotencyTestBase):
    def test_none_and_omitted_keep_legacy_behavior(self):
        self.submit()
        first = self.start(idempotency_key=None)
        second = self.start()  # omitted
        self.assertNotEqual(first["run_id"], second["run_id"])
        self.assertIsNone(first["idempotency_key"])
        self.assertIsNone(second["idempotency_key"])
        # legacy creates never populate the dedup index
        self.assertEqual(self.store.load_idempotency("acme"), {})

    def test_key_must_be_a_non_blank_string(self):
        self.submit()
        for bad in (123, True, 3.5, [], {}, ["k"]):
            with self.assertRaises(WorkflowError) as ctx:
                self.start(idempotency_key=bad)
            self.assertEqual(ctx.exception.code, "bad_idempotency_key", repr(bad))
        for bad in ("", "   ", "\t\n"):
            with self.assertRaises(WorkflowError) as ctx:
                self.start(idempotency_key=bad)
            self.assertEqual(ctx.exception.code, "bad_idempotency_key", repr(bad))
        self.assertEqual(self.scheduler.list_runs("acme")[0], [])

    def test_key_is_trimmed_before_storage_and_match(self):
        self.submit()
        first = self.start(idempotency_key="  order-42 ")
        self.assertEqual(first["idempotency_key"], "order-42")
        again = self.start(idempotency_key="order-42")
        self.assertEqual(again["run_id"], first["run_id"])
        # whitespace-only difference never creates a second run
        self.assertEqual(len(self.scheduler.list_runs("acme")[0]), 1)
        self.assertEqual(list(self.store.load_idempotency("acme")), ["order-42"])


class DedupLifecycleTest(IdempotencyTestBase):
    def test_repeat_returns_same_run_with_latest_state(self):
        self.submit()
        first = self.start(params={"day": "mon"}, idempotency_key="k1")
        second = self.start(params={"day": "mon"}, idempotency_key="k1")
        self.assertEqual(second["run_id"], first["run_id"])
        self.assertEqual(second["idempotency_key"], "k1")

        self.scheduler.claim("acme", first["run_id"], "w1", 30)
        self.scheduler.complete("acme", first["run_id"], "step1", "w1")
        third = self.start(params={"day": "mon"}, idempotency_key="k1")
        self.assertEqual(third["run_id"], first["run_id"])
        self.assertEqual(third["status"], "running")
        self.assertEqual(third["steps"]["step1"]["status"], "succeeded")

    def test_repeat_reuses_succeeded_and_failed_runs(self):
        self.scheduler.submit("acme", "one", SOLO)
        run = self.start(workflow_id="one", idempotency_key="ok")
        self.scheduler.claim("acme", run["run_id"], "w1", 30)
        self.scheduler.complete("acme", run["run_id"], "solo", "w1")

"""Tests for the run state machine, leases, retries, history and replay."""

import os
import shutil
import tempfile
import unittest

from flowd.model import WorkflowError
from flowd.scheduler import ConflictError, LeaseError, Scheduler, backoff_seconds
from flowd.store import WorkflowStore

LINEAR = [
    {"id": "step1", "depends_on": []},
    {"id": "step2", "depends_on": ["step1"]},
    {"id": "step3", "depends_on": ["step2"]},
]


class FakeClock:
    """Injectible deterministic clock; sleeping advances virtual time."""

    def __init__(self, start=1_700_000_000.0):
        self.value = float(start)

    def __call__(self):
        return self.value

    def advance(self, seconds):
        self.value += float(seconds)
        return self.value

    def sleep(self, seconds):
        self.advance(seconds)


class SchedulerTestBase(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.root = tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="flowd-test-")
        self.addCleanup(shutil.rmtree, self.root, True)
        self.clock = FakeClock()
        self.store = WorkflowStore(self.root, clock=self.clock)
        self.scheduler = Scheduler(self.store, clock=self.clock, backoff_base=1.0)

    def workflow(self, workflow_id="etl", steps=None):
        return self.scheduler.submit("acme", workflow_id, steps or LINEAR)

    def claim(self, run_id, worker="w1", lease=30, tenant="acme"):
        return self.scheduler.claim(tenant, run_id, worker, lease)

    def complete(self, run_id, step_id, worker="w1", result=None, tenant="acme"):
        return self.scheduler.complete(tenant, run_id, step_id, worker, result)

    def finish_next(self, run_id, worker="w1"):
        """Claim and complete the next ready step."""
        step = self.claim(run_id, worker)
        return step, self.complete(run_id, step["id"], worker)


class StateMachineTest(SchedulerTestBase):
    def test_step_becomes_ready_only_after_dependencies_succeed(self):
        self.workflow()
        run = self.scheduler.start_run("acme", "etl")
        self.assertEqual(run["status"], "pending")
        self.assertEqual([s["status"] for s in run["steps"].values()],
                         ["ready", "pending", "pending"])

        self.assertEqual(self.claim(run["run_id"])["id"], "step1")
        self.assertIsNone(self.claim(run["run_id"]))
        run = self.complete(run["run_id"], "step1", result={"rows": 3})
        self.assertEqual(run["status"], "running")
        self.assertEqual(run["steps"]["step2"]["status"], "ready")
        self.assertEqual(run["steps"]["step3"]["status"], "pending")

        for sid in ("step2", "step3"):
            _, run = self.finish_next(run["run_id"])
            self.assertEqual(run["steps"][sid]["status"], "succeeded")
        self.assertEqual(run["status"], "succeeded")
        self.assertTrue(all(s["status"] == "succeeded" for s in run["steps"].values()))

    def test_claim_orders_ready_steps_deterministically(self):
        self.workflow("fan", [{"id": "b", "depends_on": []}, {"id": "a", "depends_on": []}])
        run = self.scheduler.start_run("acme", "fan")
        self.assertEqual(self.claim(run["run_id"])["id"], "a")
        self.assertEqual(self.claim(run["run_id"])["id"], "b")
        self.assertIsNone(self.claim(run["run_id"]))

    def test_at_most_one_active_lease_per_step(self):
        self.workflow()
        run = self.scheduler.start_run("acme", "etl")
        self.assertEqual(self.claim(run["run_id"], "w1")["id"], "step1")
        self.assertIsNone(self.claim(run["run_id"], "w2"))

    def test_complete_is_idempotent_for_same_worker(self):
        self.workflow()
        run = self.scheduler.start_run("acme", "etl")
        self.claim(run["run_id"])
        first = self.complete(run["run_id"], "step1", result={"rows": 1})
        second = self.complete(run["run_id"], "step1", result={"rows": 1})
        self.assertEqual(second["steps"]["step1"]["status"], first["steps"]["step1"]["status"])
        self.assertEqual(second["steps"]["step1"]["attempt"], 1)
